It is often ridden by those who seek to inspire fear in their enemies.

The Greymane Charger is a symbol of the Gilnean strength and resilience. Its sleek, silver coat and lightning-fast speed make it a favorite among Gilnean soldiers.
The Brown Zhevra is a swift and sure-footed mount, able to navigate even the roughest terrain with ease. Its striped coat and graceful movements make it a popular choice among adventurers.
The Grim Totem Kodo is a massive, hulking beast, feared by many for its sheer size and strength. Those who ride it are said to have the power of the earth at their command.
